name: PT Gunanusa Eramandiri Tbk
summary: PT Gunanusa Eramandiri Tbk engages in the development, production, and sale of nuts and other food products created from natural ingredients. The firm's products include almond, cashew, hazelnut, peanut, walnut, snack, milk, and oil. It operates through the following segments: Contract Manufacturing and Tolling Service, Manufacturing and Distribution of Nut Products, and Others. The company was founded by Tjokro Gunawan on August 5, 1993 and is headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia.
